services:
  caddy:
    image: caddy:2-alpine
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./generated/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      - ./data/app:/var/www/app:ro
      - ./data/blog:/var/www/blog:ro
      - ./data/web:/var/www/html:ro
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config
    depends_on:
      - api
      - blog
    restart: unless-stopped
  api:
    image: node:20-alpine
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
    restart: unless-stopped
  blog:
    image: php:8.3-fpm
    volumes:
      - ./data/blog:/var/www/blog
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  caddy_data:
  caddy_config:
